name: ICE LINED REFRIGERATOR (ILR)
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Ice Lined Refrigerator (ILR) is designed to maintain 0°C to 8°C for 20 to 25 hours without power supply. Lined with high-quality ice packs, this direct cooling refrigerator is ideal for transporting and storing vaccines, medicines, and blood bags in remote areas.
features: Over 25 hours hold over time without power
Inner walls lined with high quality plastic ice packs
Microprocessor temperature controller with sensor error alarms
Corrosion-free stainless steel 304 interior and powder-coated exterior
Direct cooling mechanism optimized for off-grid clinical setups
